title: Weighted approximate tangent spaces of two carriers agree almost everywhere on their overlap
statement: Let N, k ∈ ℕ and H := μHE[k] on ℝ^N = Eucl N. Let M₁, M₂ ⊆ ℝ^N be H-null-measurable and let θ₁, θ₂ : ℝ^N → ℝ satisfy θ_i > 0 on M_i and θ_i H-integrable on M_i ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^N (i = 1, 2). Then for H-a.e. x ∈ M₁ ∩ M₂ (H⌞(M₁ ∩ M₂)-almost every x) and every linear subspace Q ⊆ ℝ^N: if Q is a weighted approximate tangent space of (M₁, θ₁) at x (HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M₁ θ₁ x Q, Simon Ch. 3, 1.7), then Q is a weighted approximate tangent space of (M₂, θ₂) at x.
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (M₁ M₂ : Set (Eucl N)) (θ₁ θ₂ : Eucl N → ℝ), NullMeasurableSet M₁ (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) → NullMeasurableSet M₂ (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) → (∀ x ∈ M₁, 0 < θ₁ x) → (∀ x ∈ M₂, 0 < θ₂ x) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl N), IsCompact K → IntegrableOn θ₁ (M₁ ∩ K) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N))) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl N), IsCompact K → IntegrableOn θ₂ (M₂ ∩ K) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N))) → ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)).restrict (M₁ ∩ M₂)), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl N), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M₁ θ₁ x Q → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M₂ θ₂ x Q
